title: oaky charred Irish lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew featuring charred Irish lamb, dulce de leche, and nuka-pickle, served in a mason jar. This dish is inspired by traditional Irish cuisine with a twist of international flavors.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the lamb cubes with 2 tablespoons of olive oil and 1 teaspoon of salt until they are evenly coated.
Spread the lamb cubes on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes, or until they are browned on all sides.
In a large pot, combine the roasted lamb, dulce de leche, nuka-pickle, carrots, potatoes, onions, and garlic.
Add the oak chips, lamb broth, and tomato paste to the pot and stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Transfer the stew to a mason jar and seal the lid.
Let the stew cool to room temperature before refrigerating or freezing.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
